entries.name: DB2-CUSTOMERNUM-INT
entries.longDescription: A host variable representing the unique customer identifier as an integer, used for inserting new customer records into the DB2 CUSTOMER table and retrieving auto-generated identity values

entries.name: CA-FIRST-NAME
entries.longDescription: The customer's first name passed through the communication area, used as input for creating new customer records in the database

entries.name: CA-LAST-NAME
entries.longDescription: The customer's last name passed through the communication area, used as input for creating new customer records in the database

entries.name: CA-DOB
entries.longDescription: The customer's date of birth in format suitable for DB2 DATE type, used for age verification and customer demographic information

entries.name: CA-HOUSE-NAME
entries.longDescription: The name of the customer's residence (e.g., 'Rose Cottage'), part of the complete address information stored in the customer record

entries.name: CA-HOUSE-NUM
entries.longDescription: The street number of the customer's residence, part of the complete address information stored in the customer record

entries.name: CA-POSTCODE
entries.longDescription: The postal code of the customer's address, critical for location-based services and geographic analysis

entries.name: CA-PHONE-MOBILE
entries.longDescription: The customer's mobile phone number, serving as the primary contact method for customer communications

entries.name: CA-PHONE-HOME
entries.longDescription: The customer's home phone number, serving as an alternative contact method for customer communications

entries.name: CA-EMAIL-ADDRESS
entries.longDescription: The customer's email address for digital communications and electronic correspondence

entries.name: CA-RETURN-CODE
entries.longDescription: A two-digit numeric code indicating the success or failure of operations (00=success, 90=SQL error, 98=invalid commarea length). In LGACUS01, this is initialized to '00' and may be set to '98' if the commarea length validation fails

entries.name: CA-CUSTOMER-NUM
entries.longDescription: The newly assigned customer number returned to the calling program after successful customer creation, used for subsequent operations

entries.name: D2-CUSTOMER-NUM
entries.longDescription: The customer number passed to LGACDB02 program for establishing customer security credentials and linking to the security subsystem

entries.name: D2-CUSTSECR-PASS
entries.longDescription: The initial security password hash assigned to the new customer account, used for authentication purposes

entries.name: D2-CUSTSECR-STATE
entries.longDescription: The security state indicator for the customer account (N=New, indicating initial setup), used to track security credential lifecycle

entries.name: LGAC-NCS
entries.longDescription: A flag indicating whether CICS Named Counter Service is available (ON) or unavailable (NO), controlling the customer number generation strategy

entries.name: LastCustNum
entries.longDescription: The most recent customer number retrieved from the CICS Named Counter Service, used as the next customer identifier when counter service is available

entries.name: GENAcount
entries.longDescription: The name of the CICS Named Counter resource ('GENACUSTNUM') used for generating sequential customer numbers

entries.name: CA-ERROR-MSG
entries.longDescription: A formatted error message structure containing up to 90 bytes of the communication area data for diagnostic logging when errors occur. Used by both LGACUS01 and LGACDB01 for writing error details to temporary storage queues

entries.name: DFHCOMMAREA
entries.longDescription: The CICS-provided communication area structure used for passing data between programs, containing customer information and control fields defined in the LGCMAREA copybook. In LGACUS01, this serves as the business logic layer interface, receiving validated customer data and passing it to the database layer

entries.name: CA-NUM-POLICIES
entries.longDescription: A counter field in the communication area that tracks the total number of insurance policies associated with a customer account, initialized to '00' and used for business reporting

entries.name: LGACDB01
entries.longDescription: The program name literal ('LGACDB01') used in CICS LINK commands to invoke the customer database access program for persisting customer information to DB2

entries.name: WS-REQUIRED-CA-LEN
entries.longDescription: A computed field that holds the minimum required length of the communication area, calculated by adding the header length and customer data length, used to validate that the caller provided sufficient data

entries.name: WS-CA-HEADER-LEN
entries.longDescription: A constant field set to +18 bytes, representing the fixed-size header portion of the communication area that contains control information before the variable customer data

entries.name: WS-CUSTOMER-LEN
entries.longDescription: A field defined in the LGPOLICY copybook that specifies the size of the customer data structure, used in commarea length validation calculations

entries.name: WS-HEADER
entries.longDescription: A diagnostic structure containing runtime information including eyecatcher ('LGACUS01------WS'), transaction ID, terminal ID, task number, commarea address pointer, and commarea length for debugging and operational monitoring

entries.name: ERROR-MSG
entries.longDescription: A formatted error message structure containing date, time, program name ('LGACUS01'), and variable error details, used for writing diagnostic information to temporary storage queues via the LGSTSQ program

entries.name: LGAPDB01
entries.longDescription: The program name literal ('LGAPDB01') used in CICS LINK commands to invoke the policy database access program for persisting insurance policy information (Endowment, House, Motor, Commercial) to DB2

entries.name: TIME1
entries.longDescription: A formatted time field (HH:MM:SS format) obtained from CICS FORMATTIME command, used in error message structures for diagnostic logging with precise timestamp information

entries.name: DATE1
entries.longDescription: A formatted date field (MM/DD/YYYY format) obtained from CICS FORMATTIME command, used in error message structures for diagnostic logging with precise date information

entries.name: ABS-TIME
entries.longDescription: A CICS absolute time value (binary fullword) obtained from ASKTIME command, representing the number of milliseconds since midnight January 1, 1900, used as input to FORMATTIME for converting to human-readable date and time formats
